verdict.rationale: The docs say Customer Studio "builds traits and audiences on top" of resolved identities in the warehouse, which implies computed traits that marketers can use when building no-code audiences. Nothing in the pack shows predictive scoring such as LTV, churn or purchase propensity. AI Decisioning recommends message, channel and timing, which is not a profile-level predictive score. Missing for 10: predictive LTV/churn/propensity scores, documentation of how computed traits are defined and calculated, explicit evidence that traits and scores are selectable in audience filters, independent corroboration.
